headings.usage: Used for main module titles, hero text, and high-level dashboard headers to give a premium, authoritative SaaS feel.

body.usage: Used for all UI elements, tables, forms, and cards for maximum readability and a clean modern aesthetic.

colors.accent: Semantic use of red only. Limit full red backgrounds to primary CTA buttons, badges, and alerts. Use subtle red opacity (e.g., bg-red-500/10) for active navigation states.

home_launcher.container: max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
home_launcher.header: Flex row, between items: Logo, global search (Ctrl+K) trigger in center, Notification bell & User avatar on right.
home_launcher.needs_attention: A dedicated section at the top. Use an attention-grabbing but clean card layout. E.g., grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4. Alerts should have subtle red or amber left borders.
home_launcher.module_grid: Application-launcher style. grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mt-8. Cards should be heavily padded (p-6), rounded-xl, with an icon, title, short description, and optional status badge.

module_inner.topbar: h-16 flex items-center justify-between px-6 border-b border-border bg-surface. Sticky top. Glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl bg-surface/70.
module_inner.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-border bg-surface h-full flex flex-col

components.module_card: rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-6 shadow-sm transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/50 cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center text-center gap-3
components.stat_card: rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-6 flex flex-col gap-2
components.data_table: w-full text-sm text-left. The header must be font-medium bg-muted/50. Rows hover state: hover:bg-muted/30. Use Shadcn Table component. Limit borders.
components.status_badge: inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium. Use soft backgrounds (bg-green-500/10 text-green-600).
components.command_palette: Global search triggered by Ctrl+K. Large centered modal, blurred backdrop. Group results by 'Modules', 'Clients', 'Tickets'.
components.alert_card: rounded-lg border-l-4 border-l-primary bg-surface p-4 shadow-sm flex items-start gap-3
components.button: rounded-md font-medium transition-colors. Primary uses the brand red. Secondary uses outline.
components.confirmation_modal: For danger actions: strictly use a red primary button, clear warning text, and require user to click 'Confirm'.

motion.hover_effects: Subtle transforms (e.g., hover:-translate-y-1) and box-shadow changes for cards.
motion.page_transitions: Fade-in with slight upward translate (opacity-0 translate-y-4 to opacity-100 translate-y-0 duration-300).
motion.dropdowns: Fast fade-in and scale-in (scale-95 to scale-100).
motion.alerts: Staggered entrance for 'Needs Your Attention' cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards against backgrounds, particularly when using the red brand color.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible ring (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2).
accessibility.keyboard: Command palette (Ctrl+K) ensures power-user keyboard navigability.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='module-card-clients').

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Keep stroke width consistent (1.5 or 2). Compact and clearly recognizable.
media.images: Not heavily image-dependent, but user avatars and app logos should be rounded or circular.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the home launcher screen strictly using a grid-based card layout, avoiding a permanent sidebar. Use max-width container for desktop.
Create the 'Needs Your Attention' list as a high-priority visual row above the launcher grid.
For the inside of modules (Clients, Apps, etc.), switch to a two-column layout: a left sidebar for sub-navigation and a main content area.
Use Shadcn UI components for buttons, inputs, dropdowns, tables, and dialogs. Use purely JavaScript files (.jsx) as requested.
Implement light and dark mode support using Tailwind's 'dark:' prefix. Dark mode must use a true-black or very dark slate (#020617) to maintain high contrast with the red accent.
Incorporate a mock Command Palette component that listens for Ctrl+K.
Use Fraunces font for large module headings and Manrope (or Inter) for dashboard content, stats, and tables.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition like 'transition: all'. Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
Do not use complete transparent background in headers or overlays.
